wth.text: Hanna leaves Tolaria to study artifice at Argivian University in New Argive, becoming estranged from her father, and there she befriends Orim and the two join the crew of the Weatherlight.
Gerrard falls in love with the navigator, but when he leaves after Rofellos dies, Hanna feels abandoned, until years later he rejoins and their love rekindles.
Stranded on Rath, Hanna kills a shapeshifter in the Skyshroud forest, saves the ship from burning with an improvised lightning rod, and shares a long kiss with Gerrard.

tmp.text: On Rath, the Predator attacks, Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the Weatherlight.
She defeats a shapeshifter and bonds with Mirri, who admits that she thought Hanna a burden, and both are taken prisoner by the Skyshroud elves.
Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal and allies the crew with the elven rebels, and Hanna helps Karn win the Legacy back after she realizes how the Sliver hive mind works.
When Lyna tells her that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath, the crew leaves.

exo.text: Hanna stands with Karn over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents, and as Ertai reports that the portal is open but not for long, she doubts what the skyshaper will do to the ship.

mmq.text: Hanna's Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia, where the Cho-Arrim attack and she and others are arrested.
The crew escapes Mercadia City with the Cho-Arrim prisoners, and when Takara brokers a deal, Hanna heads to Saprazzo with Sisay and Orim to fetch the Power Matrix.
The Mercadians steal the Matrix and frame the women, and Takara, morphing into Volrath, takes Hanna and Karn captive and forces Hanna to repair the Weatherlight.
During the Revolution on Mercadia the crew escapes aboard the empowered Weatherlight with Ramos's help.

apc.text: Barrin forbids Hanna from studying artifacts, causing a falling-out and her move to New Argive, and when Yawgmoth's death cloud enters the plane, it briefly turns Hanna, Barrin and Rayne into undead.
Hanna arrives in Saprazzo seeking the Power Matrix with Sisay and Orim, and she later drags the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold before the Weatherlight crosses the portal.
Meanwhile Gerrard rejects Yawgmoth's false Hanna, shouting "You're not my Hanna!"
